content.short: Galxe is the leading Web3 community platform enabling credential-based campaigns and NFT reward distribution for thousands of blockchain projects.
content.description: Galxe is one of the largest Web3 community-building platforms with tens of millions of users across hundreds of blockchain projects, enabling protocols to create credential-based campaigns where users earn NFT credentials and token rewards for on-chain and off-chain activities. Its native credential graph tracks user activity across chains, building verifiable on-chain reputation profiles. Galxe's infrastructure is widely used by Mantle ecosystem projects to launch campaigns, distribute tokens, and build loyal communities at scale.
content.meta: Galxe is the leading Web3 community platform for credential campaigns and rewards on Mantle. Discover Galxe on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
